## Problem and change

Explain the user problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Include screenshots for visible changes and disposable fixtures for rendering/export bugs. State anything not verified.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] No secrets, real private documents or raw account evidence are included.
- [ ] Draft safety, privacy and accessibility were considered where relevant.
- [ ] Checks appropriate to this change passed, or limitations are explained.

Maintainers approve deployment separately from code review.
